blurb: Welcome to Green Tree Golf Club, a public golf course in Victorville, California offering affordable, fun golf in the High Desert. Designed by William F. Bell, ASGCA, the par-72 Green Tree Golf Course opened in October 1963 and remains a welcoming place for local golfers, visiting players, families, outing groups, and anyone looking for an enjoyable round of golf.
hoursText: of operation: Open Daily 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM
